title: Resumption of Inter-school Games and Sports Competitions
what_it_is: Resumption of Inter-school Games and Sports Competitions

sections.label: National Schools Games resumption plan
sections.summary: MOE plans to resume National Schools Games sports in phases in 2022, starting with vaccinated secondary and junior college students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Earlier this year, MOE announced the cancellation of the remaining National Schools Games for 2021 due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in our community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our current plan is to resume all sports in the National Schools Games, in a phased approach, next year in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As majority of our secondary school and junior college and Millennia Institute students would have been vaccinated, we aim to resume all sports for the National Schools Games for this group of students first.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As for primary school students, the pace of resumption would depend on whether younger students would be eligible to be vaccinated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For this group of students, similar to what was practised earlier this year, we will resume with low-risk non-contact sports such as badminton, table tennis, tennis and volleyball before higher risk contact sports such as basketball, football, hockey and rugby are considered.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: If necessary, we will make modifications to the games and competition format to mitigate some of the risk involved in these games.
